Maya: Quick heads-up — planning a small rolling deploy of sdk-3.4.0 bridge this Wed 09:30 PT. Who can own smoke + rollback readiness?
Arjun: I can own smoke checks. Will run the test matrix and verify telemetry.
Liam: I can stand by for rollback if something flakes. Which regions are in the initial canary?
Maya: Canary = us-west1 (10%), eu-west1 (5%). No APAC in canary. Full rollout after a clean 45m window.
Sofia: Quick Q — are there any breaking client changes we flagged? I thought we kept the surface stable.
Maya: No API surface breaks. Two optional query param renames but backward compatible — clients will still accept old keys. We'll have a compatibility shim for older clients.
Jen: For smoke, I can run: auth flows, streaming responses, embeddings sanity, and our SDKs compatibility test. Need the canary bucket list and a short runbook.
Maya: Runbook snippet below (short):
```
1) Trigger canary deploy (deploy-bot)
2) Run smoke tests: sdk-compat.sh 
3) Monitor latency/errors in Redwood Console -> /dashboards/sdk-3.4-canary
4) If >3% error or >200ms p95 increase, roll back immediately
```
Callie: @Maya please paste the rollback command. I'll be watching.
Maya: Rollback command: ```deployctl rollback --service=sdk-bridge --to-tag=stable-3.3.9 --region=$REGION```
Arjun: I'll push a small script to ci/ops that runs the 6 smoke checks and posts results to the thread. Example: `ci/smoke/sdk_3_4_check.yml`
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary for sdk-3.4.0 scheduled at 2024-04-10T16:30:00Z by @Maya
Liam: If we hit a regression, what's the SLA for rollback? Immediate decision or 15m investigation?
Maya: Immediate rollback if severe (data loss, auth failures). For perf regressions we'll give 15m for mitigation (tuning batching/kv cache) before rollback.
Sofia: Can we gate by telemetry? I'd prefer to fail-fast if error-rate >1% on critical endpoints.
Arjun: Agreed. I'll set an alert: error-rate-critical > 1% OR p95-latency increase > 150ms -> auto-ping this channel + ops-oncall.
Jen: I'll run the SDK integration tests 5m before the window to ensure no flakiness.
Callie: I'll be primary to execute rollback if needed. @Liam you are secondary.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll post the canary bucket IDs and the smoke script link in 30m. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can take the tasks.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Arjun: :thumbsup:
Jen: :thumbsup:
Sofia: :thumbsup:
